how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIIT Vadodara Assistant Professor Grade-II Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIIT Vadodara to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIIT Vadodara Assistant Professor Grade-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Assistant Professor Grade-II position at IIIT Vadodara is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor Grade-II post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 25 vacancies announced for the Assistant Professor Grade-II position by IIIT Vadodara.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the Assistant Professor Grade-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Professor Grade-II post will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 70,900 to Rs. 98,200 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIIT Vadodara Assistant Professor Grade-II recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q5. Where is IIIT Vadodara located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Information Technology Vadodara is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, with the pincode 382028.

faq.question: Q6. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IIITV/ESTT/RECT/FACULTY/26-27/01.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee mentioned for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, no application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Offline applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Assistant Professor Grade-II post?
faq.answer: The job type for the Assistant Professor Grade-II position is Full Time.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIIT Vadodara?
faq.answer: The official website of Indian Institute of Information Technology Vadodara is http://www.iiitvadodara.ac.in.
